purpose: Bound memory, reuse per-row transformations, batch model calls, make search semantics explicit
hypothesis: Less repeated preprocessing and model-call overhead; bounded sparse storage reduces peak memory
comparison: Same algorithm, features, model and rows; changes to search algorithm require a separate OOF experiment
validation_plan: Existing unit tests plus small synthetic batched/serial equivalence and timing checks

tests.scope: synthetic contracts; real small booster; CPU rapidfuzz/tfidf batch/serial/reverse/single equivalence

limitations: No full-data speed or OOF claim
No Windows execution or CUDA validation
Legacy assets require explicit algorithm selection
Sparse float32 TF-IDF is not bitwise equivalent to historical dense float16 GPU search
validation_note: Initial failures: leakage contract rejected new input-derived fields; tiny TF-IDF fixture had no shared vocabulary. Contract retained target/fold exclusion; fixture given shared suffix. Final 22 tests passed.
